original.prompt: Consider the following statements about goals mentioned in Prime Minister Modi's Independence Day address of August 2026:
items: Lakhpati Didis are rural women who earn at least INR 100,000 a year through village savings groups.
The government's standing target is 100 GW of nuclear power by 2047.
The IndiaAI Mission was first launched in 2026.
original.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
original.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because the IndiaAI Mission has run since 2024, and the new pledge to train 10 million young people in AI scales it up. Modi also reaffirmed a target of 60 million Lakhpati Didis.
original.source: Modi reaffirmed his administration's standing goals: 60 million Lakhpati Didis, rural women who earn at least INR 100,000 (USD 1,050) a year through village savings groups; 100 GW of nuclear power by 2047; and more semiconductor plants.

rewritten.prompt: Consider the following statements about goals mentioned in Prime Minister Modi's Independence Day address of August 2026:
items: Lakhpati Didis are rural women who earn at least INR 100,000 a year through village savings groups.
The government's standing target is 100 GW of nuclear power by 2047.
The IndiaAI Mission, which the new AI training pledge scales up, has run since 2024.
rewritten.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
rewritten.explain: All three statements are correct: Lakhpati Didis earn at least INR 100,000 a year through village savings groups, the nuclear target is 100 GW by 2047, and the pledge to train 10 million young people in AI scales up the IndiaAI Mission that has run since 2024. Modi also reaffirmed a target of 60 million Lakhpati Didis.
